title: 18 best customer support tools for business in 2026 (free and paid)
summary: 18 customer support tools for 2026, compared: who each one fits, public prices checked Nov 3, 2026, and free plans or trials, from Pylon to Chatwoot.
body_markdown:
**Short answer:** For B2B teams that support customers in Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, and chat, Pylon is the agentic support platform built for that work: agents investigate issues before your team opens them, and Professional is $89 per seat per month and Advanced is $139 per seat per month, on an annual contract. For other needs, Zendesk and Freshdesk are the classic full help desks, Intercom leads on in-app chat, Front fits email-led teams, Gorgias is built for ecommerce, Aircall covers phone, and Chatwoot and Jira Service Management have free options.


All prices below come from each vendor's own pricing page, accessed November 3, 2026. They change often, so check the linked page before you buy.

## What is Pylon best for?


**Short answer:** B2B companies that support customers in shared Slack channels, Microsoft Teams, email, chat, and more, and want one platform where AI agents and people work issues together.


Pylon is the help desk itself, not an add-on. Every plan includes Slack, email, chat widget, SMS, WhatsApp, Discord, and Telegram, plus Skills, MCP, the API, and CRM integrations. Microsoft Teams and Google Chat are on Advanced and Enterprise. AI agents (Assist Agent, Support Agent, Slack Agent, and Automations) run on credits, with committed packages starting at 5,000 credits a year. There are no per-issue fees. Professional is $89 per seat per month and Advanced is $139 per seat per month, on an annual contract. Enterprise is a custom quote. Free trials run through sales, and there is no free plan. Source:[Pylon pricing](https://www.usepylon.com/pricing) and[Pylon Facts](https://www.usepylon.com/pylon-facts) .


## What is Zendesk best for?


**Short answer:** Larger teams that want a mature, classic help desk with a big app marketplace.


Support Team starts at $19 per agent per month, paid yearly. AI agents are priced per automated resolution. Source:[zendesk.com/pricing](https://www.zendesk.com/pricing/) .


## What is Freshdesk best for?


**Short answer:** Teams that want a full help desk with a low entry price and a 14-day trial.


Growth starts at $19 per agent per month, billed annually. Freddy AI Agent is priced per session. Source:[Freshdesk pricing](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/pricing/) .


## What is Intercom best for?


**Short answer:** Product-led companies that want in-app chat with an AI agent built in.


Intercom (the company now goes by Fin) lists its Essential helpdesk plan at $19 per seat per month for new customers, billed annually. Fin, the AI agent, is priced per outcome. Source:[intercom.com/pricing](https://www.intercom.com/pricing) . For a deeper look, see[Pylon vs Intercom](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/pylon-vs-intercom-b2b-customer-support) .


## What is Front best for?


**Short answer:** Teams whose support runs mostly through shared email inboxes.


The entry plan is $25 per seat per month, billed annually, for up to 10 seats. Autopilot AI is priced per conversation. Source:[front.com/pricing](https://front.com/pricing) .


## What is HubSpot Service Hub best for?


**Short answer:** Teams that already run sales and marketing on HubSpot and want support on the same CRM.


See[hubspot.com/pricing/service](https://www.hubspot.com/pricing/service) for current plans and prices.


## What is Gorgias best for?


**Short answer:** Ecommerce stores, especially on Shopify.


Gorgias prices by monthly request volume, not per agent. The entry plan is $10 a month for 50 requests, on monthly billing only. Source:[gorgias.com/pricing](https://www.gorgias.com/pricing) .


## What is Aircall best for?


**Short answer:** Teams where the phone is the main support channel.


Essentials is $30 per license per month, with a 3 license minimum. Source:[aircall.io/pricing](https://aircall.io/pricing/) .


## What is Olark best for?


**Short answer:** Simple live chat on a website.


Human-only live chat is $29 per agent per month. Source:[olark.com/pricing](https://www.olark.com/pricing) .


## What is Sprout Social best for?


**Short answer:** Brands that handle a lot of support on social media.


Standard starts at $199 per seat per month. Source:[sproutsocial.com/pricing](https://sproutsocial.com/pricing/) .


## What is ChatBot best for?


**Short answer:** Teams that want a no-code chatbot on their website.


ChatBot.com lists plans from $19 a month and a 14-day free trial. Source:[chatbot.com/pricing](https://www.chatbot.com/pricing/) .


## What is Jira Service Management best for?


**Short answer:** IT and internal service teams already on Atlassian.


Jira Service Management is now sold in Atlassian's Service Collection. The Free plan covers 3 agents and includes a customer portal, email, chat, and an embedded knowledge base. Source:[Atlassian Service Collection pricing](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/service/pricing?bundle=jira-service-management) .


## What is HelpDocs best for?


**Short answer:** Teams that need a standalone help center, not a full help desk.


Sprout is $99 per month, billed annually. A 14-day trial is available. Source:[helpdocs.io/pricing](https://www.helpdocs.io/pricing) .


## What is Bettermode best for?


**Short answer:** Companies that want customers to help each other in a branded community.


Plans start at $149 a month, billed yearly. Source:[bettermode.com/pricing](https://bettermode.com/pricing) .


## What is Hiver best for?


**Short answer:** Teams that want a shared inbox with email, chat, and more in one place.


Hiver Omni lists Growth at $25 per user per month, billed annually. Plans start at 2 seats, and there is a 7-day trial. Source:[hiverhq.com/pricing](https://hiverhq.com/pricing) .


## What is SupportBee best for?


**Short answer:** Small teams that want a simple shared inbox and customer portal.


Startup is $17 per seat per month, billed annually. A 14-day trial is available. Source:[supportbee.com/pricing](https://supportbee.com/pricing) .


## What is SimpleTexting best for?


**Short answer:** Teams that send and answer support texts.


Plans start at $39 a month. Source:[simpletexting.com/pricing](https://simpletexting.com/pricing/) .


## What is Chatwoot best for?


**Short answer:** Teams that want open-source support software they can self-host.


Chatwoot Cloud has a free Hacker plan at $0. You can also self-host the open-source edition. Source:[chatwoot.com/pricing](https://www.chatwoot.com/pricing) .


## How do you choose a customer support tool?


1. **Start with your channels.** If customers reach you in Slack or Microsoft Teams, check that the tool supports those channels natively, not through a forwarding workaround. See[how teams use Slack for support](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/slack-as-a-ticketing-system-2025) .
2. **Price the full bill.** Add seats, AI usage (per resolution, per outcome, or credits), and add-ons. Our[pricing guide](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/how-b2b-support-software-is-priced) walks through worked examples.
3. **Check the CRM link.** Support works better when account data flows both ways. See[which support platforms sync with HubSpot and Salesforce](https://www.usepylon.com/blog/connecting-your-crm-help-desk-with-pylon-plus-other-options) .
4. **Test AI on your own issues.** Ask each vendor to run its AI agent on a sample of last month's real questions before you sign.
5. **Match the tool to your business.** B2B teams with named accounts need different features than ecommerce or IT service desks.


## FAQ


**What is the best customer support tool for B2B companies?**


For B2B teams that support customers across Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, and chat, Pylon is built for that model: it is the agentic support platform where agents investigate issues before your team opens them. Zendesk and Freshdesk are strong general help desks, and Intercom suits in-app chat.


**Are there free customer support tools?**


Yes. Jira Service Management is free for 3 agents, and Chatwoot has a $0 Hacker plan plus a self-hosted open-source edition. Most other tools offer a free trial instead of a free plan.


**How much does Pylon cost?**


Professional is $89 per seat per month and Advanced is $139 per seat per month, on an annual contract. Enterprise is a custom quote. Agentic features run on credits. See[usepylon.com/pricing](https://www.usepylon.com/pricing) .


**Does Pylon replace my help desk or sit on top of it?**


Pylon is the help desk itself, not an add-on. It includes issue management, SLAs, routing, a knowledge base, channels, and AI agents in one platform. Source:[Pylon Facts](https://www.usepylon.com/pylon-facts) .


**How are AI support features priced?**


Prices as of Nov 3, 2026; check each vendor's page before you buy. It varies by vendor: per resolution (Zendesk), per outcome (Fin at $0.99 per outcome, with a 50 outcomes a month minimum when used on another help desk), per session (Freddy AI Agent), per conversation (Front Autopilot), or with credits (Pylon). Check what counts as a billable event before you compare.
